book.name: 1 Tasaloniya
book.title: Ukanikorongi u Kagita̱ Ubana a Asu u Aza a Tasaloniya

content: Manyan ma Bulus a Tasaloniya
Ama a va̱, i reve ta̱ gai utuwa̱ u ɗa tsu tuwa̱i tsu kyawan ɗa̱ u gbani u ɗa wa.

I reve ta̱ an tsa̱ri a Filibi kahu tsu tuwa̱ ara ɗe. Nte a zuwa tsu tsu panai ikyamba pini kpam a yanka tsu tsilai. Shegai Kashila̱ ka tsunu ka na̱ka̱ tsu ta̱ ugbami u asuvu u ɗa tsa tonusuko ɗa̱ Kadyanshi ka Shinga ka ne a kateshe, ko an u wokoi ama ushani pini a ka ka̱ngusu tsu ta̱.
Akani a ɗa tsu tuko ɗa̱, aꞌa̱ri n kaɓan wa. Tsu tuko ɗa̱ a ɗa tsa̱ra̱ tsu yain ugboji wa. Ryafa ɗa tsa ciga tsu ryafa ɗa̱ wa. Nala wa̱ri wa, ko kenu!

Kashila̱ ka wene tsu ta̱ tsa̱ri mai ɗa gai i zuwai u na̱ka̱ tsu Kadyanshi ka Shinga ka ne tsa̱ra̱ tsu tonusuko aza ɗa a buwai vi. Ili iꞌya tsa ciga iꞌya, tsu zuwa Kashila̱ ka pana kayanyan, kpaci aya uza ɗa u kondoi atakasuvu a tsunu. Tsu tsu zuwuka kadyanshi ka ama atsuvu wa.
I reve ta̱ mai tsu tsu cikpala ɗa̱ n kaɓan wa, kpam Kashila̱ n kaci ka ne wa wenishike ta̱ ili iꞌya tsu yain adama a kurura a ɗa wa.
Tsu tsu yan ili adama a ɗa tsa tsa̱ra̱ tsupige ara ɗe, ko ara uza wa. Kpaci a̱tsu asuki a Kawauwi a ɗa, tsa fuɗa ta̱ tsa yanka ucira u nala manyan tsu zuwa ɗa̱ i na̱ka̱ tsu ili iꞌya tsa ciga.
Shegai tsu yan nala wa, aku tsu vakunki kaci utuwa̱ ara ɗe tyoku ɗa mma u tsu comuko kpam u kirana na̱ mmuku n ne.
Tsu ciga ɗa̱ ta̱ cika kpam tsu pana ta̱ kayanyan tsu tuko ɗa̱ Kadyanshi ka Shinga ka Kashila̱, kpam dem tsu pana ta̱ kayanyan tsu ɓa̱nga̱ ɗa̱ a ili dem, kpaci i woko ɗe aza ɗa tsa ciga cika.

Ama a va̱, i ciɓa ta̱ tyoku ɗa tsu yain manyan cika an tsa̱ri kaɓolo n a̱ɗa̱. Kaara n kayin tsu tsu moɗono ta̱ tsu tsa̱ra̱ ikebe tsa̱ra̱ ili iꞌya baci dem tsa ciga tsu tsila i woko ili kadambula ara uza wa, aꞌayin a ɗa tsa̱ri pini n tsu yanyi kuɓari ku Kadyanshi ka Shinga ka Kashila̱.
Eɗa ama a tsunu aza ɗa i wenei ukuna vi n aꞌeshi a ɗe, nala dem Kashila̱, a̱tsu tsa̱ ta̱ sarara n ukuna u mayun, ko uza wa na̱ka̱ tsu unyushi tyoku ɗa tsu yanka ɗa̱ wa, eɗa aza ɗa i wushuki n Asheku.
Kpam i reve ta̱ tsu tono ta̱ n a̱ɗa̱ mai tyoku ɗa tata u tsu tono na̱ mmuku n ne.
Tsu folo ɗa̱ ta̱, kpam tsu gbamatangu ɗa̱ ta̱. Tsu zuwa ta̱ ya dem u rongo ure u ɗa wa na̱ka̱ Kashila̱ tsupige, kpaci u isa̱ ɗa̱ ta̱ i uwa a tsugono tsu ne i tsa̱ra̱ kaɓon a tsupige tsu ne.

Kain dem tsu tsu cikpa ta̱ Kashila̱ an i wushuki n akani a ɗa tsu tuko ɗa̱. I danai idani i tsunu i ama iꞌya koshi wa. I wushai akani yi dere tyoku ɗa aꞌa̱ri mayun: Akani a Kashila̱ a ɗa. Kpam akani a nala yi a ka rongo ta̱ uyan manyan ara ɗe aza ɗa i wushuki.

Ama a va̱, an i wushuki n ili iꞌya tsu danai, ama a ɗe a foro ɗa̱ ta̱. Nala i wokoi tyoku u Atoni a Kashila̱ a ɗa aꞌa̱ri a Yahuda. Ama a nala yi a wushuku ta̱ n Yesu Kawauwi, aku ama a le aza a Yahuda a foro le dem.

Aza a Yahuda a nala yi a wuna ta̱ ntsumate n le, hal aza roku a le gba̱m a wunai Yesu Asheku. Gogo‑na a zuwa tsu ta̱ tsu panai ikyamba kpam a loko tsu. Ama a nala yi a yan ili iꞌya Kashila̱ ka pana kayanyan wa, kpam a ɓishinkai gba̱ ama uwusha ukuna u shinga,
kpaci a ɓishinka tsu ta̱ tsu dansa n Awulawa tsa̱ra̱ kotsu a tsa̱ra̱ iwauwi wa. Nala a rongoi uyansa n a dokusi unyushi u cingi u le. Aku Kashila̱ ka tuwa̱i ka yain upan, u yan le mavura.
Bulus wa ciga u doku u kyawan le
Ama a va̱, an a loko tsu ara ɗe, tsu ɓa̱ra̱kpa̱ wa, she na tsu ma̱tsa̱i cika tsu gono. Tsu a̱sa̱ka̱ uciɓusa n a̱ɗa̱ wa, ko kenu, kpam tsu ciga ta̱ tsu wene ɗa̱ cika.
Mayun ɗa tsa ciga ɗa̱ uwene. Mpa Bulus, n ma̱tsa̱ ta̱ aꞌayin ushani tsa̱ra̱ n tuwa̱ ara ɗe, shegai Kanangasi
ka ka̱ngu mu ta̱.

Ili iꞌya i zuwai ma ciga n wene ɗa̱ iꞌya, i tuko tsu ta̱ uzuwa u uma, i na̱ka̱ tsu kpam maza̱nga̱, kpam eɗa funi u utsa̱ra̱ u kaci u tsunu. Ya zuwa tsu ta̱ tsu yain maza̱nga̱ a kapala ka Yesu Asheku aꞌayin a ɗa baci u tuwa̱i.
Eɗa tsupige tsu tsunu, eɗa kpam maza̱nga̱ ma tsunu.

footnotes.text: Kanangasi; wata, “Shetan” kala ka dem ka Kala̱pa̱nsi.
